headline: Aguas Andinas Reports Third-Quarter Net Profit Increase of 28.8%
summary: Chilean sanitary utility Aguas Andinas posted third-quarter profits of 27.731 billion pesos, up 28.8% year-on-year, alongside a 5.9% increase in revenue.
why: Utility providers serve as defensive holdings for investors, with earnings driven by regulated tariff structures and water availability.

impacts.why: Higher net income and revenue growth demonstrate improved quarterly operational performance.
